title: Maalinta Bandhigga Ugu Dambeeya
intro: Markii loogu yeeray bandhig awoodeed oo weyn, koox farshaxanleyaal xirfad leh ayaa is arkay iyagoo wajahaya xaqiiqo lama filaan ah oo beddeli doonta noloshooda weligeed.
clues: Waxaan caan ku ahayn farsamadayada, sayidyada khayaaliga iyo khiyaanada.
Waxaa naloo yeeray taliye si aan ula dagaallanno qof caqabad ku ah oo haysta ul fudud.
Markii aan runta aragnay, ayaan sujuudnay, annagoo ku dhawaaqayna rumaynta Rabbiga Caalamka.
Kaligii-taliyihii wuxuu nagu hanjabay ciqaab daran, laakiin ma aanan quusan.
Waxaan ka mid ahayn kuwii ugu horreeyay ee rumaystay farriinta ka dib markii aan aragnay calaamadda cad.
Waxaan u shahiiday iimaankeenna awgiis, laakiin waxaan noqon doonnaa kuwa ugu horreeya ee Jannada la gala kuwa xaqa ah.

outcome.label: Natiijo
options: Waxaa lagu qodbay iskutallaabta meel fagaare ah
Waxaa laga dhigay kuwa raaca nebiga
outcome.answer: Waxaa lagu qodbay iskutallaabta meel fagaare ah

arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verse: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses." (20:70)
